title: Coming from Python
text: Copy--modify: Python modifies scenes layers place (scene.add_layers(layer)), R returns modified copies (sc <- ngs_add_layers(sc, layer)). Functions instead methods: methods become ngs_-prefixed functions take scene layer first argument. 1-based indexing: layers referred name position starting 1. Negative indices supported. Segment IDs character vectors, R can’t represent 64-bit integers exactly numbers. ported: LocalScene (live sync local neuroglancer server), local mesh/skeleton layers local data server.

title: Coming from Python
text: Python, scene.layers["seg"] returns layer object , editing edits scene. R either use replacement form ngs_layer(): pass scene helpers, picking layer layer:
code: library(nglscenes) sc <- ngs_scene(ngs_segmentation_layer("precomputed://gs://x/seg", name = "seg")) ngs_layer(sc, "seg")$selectedAlpha <- 0.3 sc <- ngs_add_segments(sc, c("1", "2"), layer = "seg") sc <- ngs_set_colors(sc, "red", layer = "seg")

code: sc <- ngs_scene(   ngs_image_layer("precomputed://gs://neuroglancer-fafb-data/fafb_v14/fafb_v14_clahe"),   ngs_segmentation_layer("precomputed://gs://fafb-ffn1-20200412/segmentation"),   layout = "3d" ) sc #> <ngs_scene> 2 layers: 1 image, 1 segmentation #> Base URL: https://neuroglancer-demo.appspot.com/ #> 1: <image layer> "img" precomputed://gs://neurogla...ata/fafb_v14/fafb_v14_clahe #> 2: <segmentation layer> "segmentation" precomputed:...segmentation (0 segments) sc$layout <- "xy-3d" ngs_url(sc) #> [1] "https://neuroglancer-demo.appspot.com/#!%7B%22layers%22%3A%5B%7B%22blend%22%3A%22default%22%2C%22name%22%3A%22img%22%2C%22shaderControls%22%3A%7B%7D%2C%22source%22%3A%22precomputed%3A//gs%3A//neuroglancer-fafb-data/fafb_v14/fafb_v14_clahe%22%2C%22type%22%3A%22image%22%7D%2C%7B%22name%22%3A%22segmentation%22%2C%22segments%22%3A%5B%5D%2C%22selectedAlpha%22%3A0.14%2C%22source%22%3A%22precomputed%3A//gs%3A//fafb-ffn1-20200412/segmentation%22%2C%22type%22%3A%22segmentation%22%7D%5D%2C%22layout%22%3A%22xy-3d%22%7D"

title: Segment properties — ngs_segment_properties
code: df <- data.frame(id = c(1, 2, 3),                  name = c("DA1_lPN", "DA1_lPN", "KCg"),                  size = c(10.5, 12, 3),                  class = factor(c("PN", "PN", "KC"))) props <- ngs_properties_from_df(df) props #> <ngs_segment_properties> 3 segments, 3 properties #>   name (label) #>   size (number) #>   class (tags) as.data.frame(props) #>   id    name size class #> 1  1 DA1_lPN 10.5    PN #> 2  2 DA1_lPN 12.0    PN #> 3  3     KCg  3.0    KC cat(ngs_to_json(props, pretty = TRUE)) #> { #>     "@type": "neuroglancer_segment_properties", #>     "inline": { #>         "ids": [ #>             "1", #>             "2", #>             "3" #>         ], #>         "properties": [ #>             { #>                 "id": "name", #>                 "type": "label", #>                 "values": [ #>                     "DA1_lPN", #>                     "DA1_lPN", #>                     "KCg" #>                 ] #>             }, #>             { #>                 "data_type": "float32", #>                 "id": "size", #>                 "type": "number", #>                 "values": [ #>                     10.5, #>                     12, #>                     3 #>                 ] #>             }, #>             { #>                 "id": "class", #>                 "tags": [ #>                     "KC", #>                     "PN" #>                 ], #>                 "type": "tags", #>                 "values": [ #>                     [ #>                         1 #>                     ], #>                     [ #>                         1 #>                     ], #>                     [ #>                         0 #>                     ] #>                 ] #>             } #>         ] #>     } #> }

code: seg <- ngs_segmentation_layer("precomputed://gs://x/seg", segments = 1:3) ngs_segments(seg) #> [1] "1" "2" "3"  sc <- ngs_scene(seg) sc <- ngs_add_segments(sc, c(4, 5)) sc <- ngs_remove_segments(sc, 1) ngs_segments(sc) #> [1] "2" "3" "4" "5"
